headline: Cheaper Oil Lifts Cyclicals as Software Sinks
body_html:
Stocks are leaning higher at midday Monday, with 384 of the 530 names we track rising and 142 falling. Energy set the tone. US index futures jumped early as oil dropped about 6%, even as Iran said contacts on ending the war continue after talks closed without a breakthrough. Prices are not final.

Cyclical groups lead. Homebuilders are up 3.34%, consumer names 2.34%, industrials 2.30% and materials 1.94%. Semiconductors add 0.77%, healthcare 0.36% and software a thin 0.19%. Energy is the only sector in the red, down 0.97%, in step with cheaper crude. The standout is IDEXX Labs, up 17.35%, while solar names also run hard: Nextracker is up 12.37% and Enphase Energy 8.42%.

The weak spots are specific. Napco Security Technologies is down 17.18%, and software is lagging the broader tape: Okta is off 6.65%, Datadog 5.36%, Zscaler 5.16% and MongoDB 5.14%. Marvell Technology is down 6.82%, a drag on chip leadership. Into the close, watch whether crude holds its drop, whether Iran headlines shift, and whether software finds a floor before Tuesday, November 3.

briefs.headline: Oil Slide Powers Early Futures Jump
briefs.body: Index futures climbed in early trading as crude fell roughly 6%. Cheaper oil eases cost pressure for transport-heavy and consumer-facing businesses, and it explains why energy is the lone sector lower today, down 0.97%. Whether the drop holds into the afternoon is the key question.

briefs.headline: Homebuilders Take the Lead
briefs.body: Homebuilders are the strongest sector so far, up 3.34%. Cavco Industries has gained 6.47% and flooring maker Mohawk Industries 7.74%, suggesting the move is spreading through housing-related names. Real estate brokerage eXp World Holdings is also higher, up 6.06%.

briefs.headline: Software Stumbles Against a Firm Tape
briefs.body: While most of the market advances, several software names are under pressure. Okta is down 6.65%, Datadog 5.36%, Zscaler 5.16% and MongoDB 5.14%. The sector as a whole is barely positive, up 0.19%, so the losses look concentrated in these names.

briefs.headline: Solar Stocks Surge on the Open
briefs.body: Solar-linked shares are among the day's top gainers. Nextracker is up 12.37% and Enphase Energy 8.42%. Comments from a major European energy chief that the Iran conflict could speed the shift away from fossil fuels offer a possible backdrop for the move.

briefs.headline: Oracle Moves to Fund Its AI Buildout
briefs.body: Oracle has filed to sell a large package of new stock and bonds to finance its artificial-intelligence expansion. The filing underscores how capital-hungry the AI buildout remains, and it lands on a day when several technology names are trading weaker.

briefs.headline: Fuel Markets Recover Unevenly
briefs.body: Asia's crude imports have returned to levels seen before the conflict, though refined fuel flows still trail. Separately, TotalEnergies' chief executive sees no gas shortage in Europe this winter, a view that fits with the pullback in oil prices today.
